context: A uni student and a friend discuss a sports column
purpose: Teach: イチロー/ホンダ/野村/三浦/岡本/宮本/上田/松田

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最新の記事、イチローと、ホンダ創業者の対比、面白い視点だ。
lines.en: This latest piece is interesting—the way they compare Ichiro with Honda's founder. Fresh angle.
lines.style: Lean in slightly. Warm recognition in the voice—he's found something worth sharing. Natural pace, conversational. Eyes lighting on 'fresh angle' as he lands on why he's mentioning it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 野村さんの引退表明、ネットでも話題だね。
lines.en: Yeah, Nomura-san's retirement announcement has everyone talking online.
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment. Not performing—just matching his energy and validating what he's sharing. Gentle cadence. She's listening more than explaining.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 三浦選手のインタビュー、誌面の柱だな。
lines.en: Miura's interview is really the centerpiece of the whole issue.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Pause before 'centerpiece'—he's thinking aloud, not lecturing. Reflective tone, like he's noticing something true about how the article is structured.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 岡本選手、SNSでファン層が広い。
lines.en: Okamoto's got such a wide fan base on social media, doesn't he.
lines.style: Light, genuine. A small smile underneath. She's not performing brightness—it's natural recognition of something good. Unhurried pace, like she's enjoying the observation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 宮本キャプテンの言葉、後輩への影響力すごい。
lines.en: What Captain Miyamoto said really carries weight with the younger players.
lines.style: Exploratory. Not stating a fact—probing the idea, inviting agreement. Slight rise at the end, like he's testing whether she sees it too. Thoughtful, not sure.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 上田監督の交代論、議論を呼んでる。
lines.en: Coach Ueda's comments about the team change have sparked a lot of debate.
lines.style: Energized but not breathless. She's following his thread—these topics matter. A little quicker pace here. Interest in the intensity of the discussion itself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 松田の守備統計、地味だが優秀だ。
lines.en: Matsuda's defensive statistics are quiet work, but they're genuinely excellent.
lines.style: Thoughtful conclusion. Slight warmth on 'quiet work'—respecting the unsexy skill. Steady pace, landing softly on 'excellent.' Like closing a small door gently on something well-made.
